title: Nourishing Mexican Cheese Quesadilla
description: A savory and satisfying Mexican dish featuring melted cheese and a hint of rum, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and made with score fat on a tava griddle.
instructions: Heat the tava griddle over medium heat and brush with score fat or oil.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced onion, bell pepper, and tomato.
Add the shredded cheese to the bowl and mix well.
Add the rum to the bowl, if using, and mix well.
Place a tortilla on the griddle and sprinkle a quarter of the cheese mixture on half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese mixture.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
